d0-cuts.json.meaning: IPchi2 < 9 counts with and without the TAU-missing rows; TAU > 0 count

d0-fit.json.meaning: the mass fit: start values, logged iterations (dk-curve params), result, pulls, window stability, PDG gap in sigma, mass/momentum scale shift, row 1 P(signal)

d0-psig.f32.meaning: P(signal) = S/(S+B) per candidate from the Gaussian+line fit (d0-fit.json), file order; outside 1820-1910 the fitted line is extrapolated and S is negligible

d0-score.f32.meaning: the honest 2-4-1 network's output per candidate in file order (NaN where TAU <= 0 or missing)

d0-split.f32.meaning: classifier role per candidate in file order: 0 train, 1 test, -1 not used (TAU <= 0)

d0.f32.meaning: record 401 candidates in file order: M MeV/c2, PT MeV/c, TAU ps (NaN = missing), IPCHI2

d0.json.meaning: d0.f32's header: n, cols, units, row 1, value ranges, source block

train-d0.json.meaning: record 401 classifier: majority / neuron / network accuracies, with M added, score grids over (log10 IPCHI2, TAU ps)

train-perceptron.json.meaning: course 200 points, per-epoch (loss, acc, w1, w2, b), threshold vs line, loss grid over (w1,w2) with path, train/test split

train-rare.json.meaning: rare-signal arithmetic: precision 8.3 %, accuracy of always-background 99.9 %

train-ring.json.meaning: 600-point ring set, line vs 2-4-1 network, test accuracy and AUC, score grid
